speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned a psychiatric condition and a new movement disorder; can you describe the specific symptoms you are experiencing and when they started?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. Since you recently started risperidone for schizophrenia, I need to clarify the timing of your new movement disorder: did these symptoms begin right after starting the medication, or have they been present since before your diagnosis?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-Induced Hyperkinesia (Akathisia) secondary to Risperidone.
